purpose: Advance Lane 9 exactly one audited gate: decompress CF4 table4, parse only fixed-width bytes 1 through 7 as 1PGC, freeze row hashes/offsets and SHA-256 split roles, and leave every scientific field plus all VAST and Pantheon+ bytes semantically opaque.

identifier_grammar.byte_regex: ASCII space-star, optional plus-or-minus, one-or-more decimal digits, ASCII space-star; full seven-byte match
identifier_grammar.canonical: base-10 str(integer) ASCII with no sign, spaces, or leading zeroes
identifier_grammar.forbidden: no decimal point, exponent, tab, control byte, non-ASCII byte, internal space, or inferred value

record_framing.stream_coordinate: zero-based offsets in the completely decompressed CF4 byte stream
record_framing.line_rule: each framed record ends in exactly one LF and may have exactly one CR immediately before LF; after removing that terminator, payload length must equal 157; embedded CR/LF and repeated terminators reject
record_framing.offsets: freeze framed_start, framed_end_exclusive, payload_start, payload_end_exclusive, and line_ending_bytes
record_framing.raw_hashes: for every record freeze SHA256 of exact framed bytes, exact 157-byte payload, exact seven-byte ID slice, and exact opaque 150-byte payload tail
record_framing.opaque_rule: outside bytes 0:7, the implementation may count, frame, and hash bytes but may not decode, slice into named fields, convert, compare, log, or persist raw values

split.bucket: unsigned big-endian digest bytes 0 through 7 modulo 10
split.duplicate_rule: canonical 1PGC is globally unique across all records; any repeat is a package-level block even when framed bytes or roles are identical
split.row_leaf: SHA256 of canonical JSON for the row entry excluding leaf_sha256
split.root: SHA256 of concatenated raw 32-byte leaf digests in the declared ordering; empty root is SHA256(empty bytes)
split.canonical_id_root: all leaves by (identifier integer, source_index) ascending
split.role_roots: leaves in each role by (identifier integer, source_index) ascending
split.bucket_roots: leaves in each bucket by (identifier integer, source_index) ascending

staged_minima.quantity: unique raw IDs by frozen split role before any eligibility or scientific field opens
staged_minima.scope: passing these raw-ID minima makes no assertion about future full-mask eligible counts

access_barrier.build: after all v3 and independent-audit pins validate, perform at most one CF4 gzip decompression pass if artifacts do not yet exist
access_barrier.check: verify raw compressed source hash and immutable artifacts; never decompress CF4 and never revisit a source identifier slice
access_barrier.VAST: no VAST file is opened, rehashed, decompressed, framed, or parsed by this package
access_barrier.PANTHEON: no Pantheon+ data or covariance file is opened, rehashed, framed, or parsed by this package
access_barrier.development: no nonidentifier CF4 byte is decoded and no development eligibility or response is opened
access_barrier.holdouts: validation and confirmation reveal identifier and role only; all other bytes remain opaque hashes
access_barrier.scores: no likelihood, parameter fit, permutation, correlation, per-object scientific residual, or real-data score is computed

next_gate: A distinct agent must audit the exact ledger, roots, counts, byte offsets, row hashes, grammar isolation, and zero scientific access before any development release.
